sections.title: Document list and attach handlers
sections.what: Lists a case's documents and attaches one approved sample. The body is checked against a rule that allows only a fixture id, and invalid requests are refused.
sections.why: Likely reason: restricts attachments to approved demo samples.
sections.watch_out: The fixture id rule is only a format check, so the service must still confirm the sample exists.

summary: Web address to list a case's documents and to attach one approved synthetic sample to the case.
purpose: Gives the case a documents list and lets a user add a supporting sample.
why: Likely reason: attachments are limited to approved fixtures so users cannot add arbitrary text.
how: GET loads seed documents, checks the case exists, and returns its documents. POST reads a body that may contain only a fixture id matching a safe pattern, checks the case exists, and attaches the sample. A repeat attach returns the existing record.
inputs: Case id in the address. POST body with a single fixtureId field.
outputs: GET returns a list. POST returns 201 for a new attach, 200 for a duplicate, 400 for invalid input, and 404 for an unknown case or fixture.
risks: The middle of POST is cut off in the source, so the path after validation is only partly confirmed. The pattern accepts any name that starts with fixture, so the fixture must still be checked against the real list.
debug: A 400 with INVALID_INPUT means the body failed the rule. A 404 means the case or fixture is unknown. Check the fixture list first.
